newsitem.title: USA: Cowen to shift focus to retail, high-net worth.
newsitem.headline: Cowen to shift focus to retail, high-net worth.

text.p: Rumors that Cowen & Co is exiting the municipal business are untrue, but the firm plans to de-emphasize the institutional side, Stephen Malfitano, a managing director at the firm, said Monday.
"There's a transition, there's a change," Malfitano said. "We are de-emphasizing the institutional business, and we're emphasizing and focusing on expanding retail and high net worth."
The move is a management one, he said, adding it should not be deemed to reflect negatively on the professionals in Cowen's institutional department or the firm's institutional clients.
He declined to discuss specifics regarding job cuts.
"All I'm going to say to you is that over time obviously people will be leaving on the institutional side," Malfitano said.
